title: Tokyo, Monday November 9: MAPPA EXPO, then the Kaoruhana signing in Ikebukuro
lead: We meet at Excelsior Caffé in front of Kinshicho Station at 9:00. MAPPA EXPO at Yurakucho from 10:00, lunch, then Ikebukuro for the Kaoruhana Rin to Saku 5th anniversary exhibition and the Mikami Saka signing. Entry there is at 16:00.
subject: Nov 9
pick: One day, two venues. Kinshicho to Yurakucho, then up the Yurakucho line to Ikebukuro.
hero_alt: MAPPA EXPO Attack on Titan exhibit, the 15th MAPPA entrance sign, and the Kaoruhana Rin to Saku key visual
hero_cap: Today's two stops: MAPPA EXPO at Yurakucho and the Kaoruhana exhibition in Ikebukuro. © Isayama Hajime / Kodansha / Attack on Titan The Final Season Production Committee; © Mikami Saka / Kodansha / Kaoruhana Rin to Saku Production Committee.

workshop.lead: Yuuki carries the tickets for both. Please bring your passport or ID in case staff ask for it at the signing.
facts: YURAKUCHO MUSEUM, Tokyo International Forum B1F (Yurakucho). Entry from 10:00. Open 10:00 to 18:00, last entry 17:00.
Space Galleria, Animate Ikebukuro Main Store, 8F. Entry 16:00 with the signing ticket. Last day: closes 17:00, last entry 16:30.
Mikami Saka sensei. Bring the items you want signed only as the event rules allow; check the official notice on the day.
steps: Excelsior Caffé in front of the station, 9:00. A coffee first, then we go.
Chainsaw Man, Attack on Titan, Jujutsu Kaisen and more. Give it about two hours.
Be at Space Galleria (Animate main store, 8F) a little before 16:00.
workshop.note: The goods-set ticket for MAPPA EXPO does not include goods at the venue. Goods are picked up later, so there is nothing to carry out on the day.

meet_h2: Meet at Excelsior Caffé, Kinshicho Station, 9:00
meet_text: Excelsior Caffé is right in front of Kinshicho Station. Yuuki is there from 9:00. We leave at about 9:15 on the JR Sobu Rapid line.
meet_addr: Excelsior Caffé, in front of Kinshicho Station, Sumida-ku, Tokyo
meet_hint: Your Airbnb is near the station, so it is a short walk. If you cannot find it, message Yuuki.
footer: Questions on the day: message Yuuki on LINE. Times are approximate.

print.title: Tokyo, Nov 9
directions: From Kinshicho, JR Sobu Rapid line to Tokyo Station (about 10 minutes), then walk to Tokyo International Forum (about 10 minutes).
From Yurakucho Station, Tokyo Metro Yurakucho line to Ikebukuro (about 20 minutes, no change).
Animate main store is a short walk from Ikebukuro Station. Space Galleria is on 8F.

Signing: entry 16:00, Animate Ikebukuro Main Store 8F, Space Galleria. Last entry 16:30.
